Message:
I remember every single word
you’ve ever said to me.

“I heard, that if two people
make a vow to each other
beneath the setting sun,
they will be blessed
by Heaven above.”

Fortina said those words
with the brightest smile
on her face.
So, I told her...

The two of us endured
every trial thrown at us,
so it’s high time we did it—
make a new vow.”

I broke the vow
I made once before.
My vow to protect Fortina.
With these hands, no less...

And after doing so,
everything that
Fortina and I had...
briefly came to an end.

That’s why
this promise is important.
For our severed bond
to be tied back together.
If I don’t keep it this time,

I’ll lose every right
to stay by Fortina’s side...

“I would love that.
I shall hold you
to it then, Florence.
Let us vow anew,
beneath the setting sun.”
